'''Mastakatorus Darriovof III''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] [[Nerf herder/Legends|rancher]] who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Using the title of "[[Baron/Legends|Baron]]," Darriovof controlled nerf ranches built on the plains found at the base of some [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges on Corellia. He made a handsome profit selling the meat from his ranches throughout the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mastakatorus Darriovof III was first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system. The book does not clarify his [[Species/Legends|species]].
